bodyHtml:
MEGA-2 High-Pressure Booster Tank

2-Liter (0.5 Gallon) 16-Bar Pressure Tank for High-Rise & Long-Distance Water Systems | Aquasky MEGA-PLUS Series | Made in Taiwan

MEGA-2 is an essential part of a pressurized water system designed to reliably provide water pressure at a set level, specifically engineered for high-rise buildings and long-distance pressure support.


MEGA-2 has a total volume of 2 liters (0.5 gallons). Built for demanding environments, this tank features a robust maximum operating pressure of 16 bar. To ensure highly stable and reliable system performance over time, it is factory pre-charged with nitrogen gas.


With a highly compact diameter of 12.3 cm (4.8 inches) and a height of 21.4 cm (8.4 inches), this tank is ideal for point-of-use installations and tight spaces while delivering exceptional high-pressure performance.

Price InquiryContact us

Product Overview

The MEGA-2 is a 2-liter (0.5-gallon) diaphragm pressure tank that represents the peak of high-pressure water system stabilization. The tank works by storing supplemental water between a specialized liner and a diaphragm, while the pressurized air chamber creates a highly efficient supply cycle. This mechanical process significantly reduces the number of times your pump motor must start to keep the system pressure at the set level, extending the life of your equipment.

Constructed with a heavy-duty cold-rolled carbon steel shell and protected by a triple-grade blue paint coating, the MEGA-2 is built to endure. Inside, it utilizes a heavy-duty butyl rubber diaphragm designed to maintain constant water pressure within the system, ensuring the proper operation of appliances like dishwashers and washing machines, as well as robust flow for showering and bathing.

Equipped with a premium 304 stainless steel connector, the Aquasky MEGA-PLUS series provides an energy-saving, maintenance-free, high-water-pressure solution that you can depend on.

Key Features & Design Advantages

  • 16-Bar high-pressure rating for high-rise buildings and long-distance pipelines.
  • Cold rolled carbon steel shell offers exceptional structural integrity under extreme pressure.
  • 304 stainless steel connection ensures secure, rust-free, durable integration.
  • Heavy-duty butyl rubber diaphragm withstands frequent cycling and maintains constant pressure.
  • Triple-grade blue paint coating provides superior exterior protection.
  • 100% Nitrogen pre-charged to prevent pressure loss common with compressed air.
  • 100% made in Taiwan.

How the MEGA-PLUS Pressure Tank Works

The MEGA-2 stores supplemental water between the liner and the heavy-duty butyl rubber diaphragm. When a faucet is opened or an appliance demands water, the compressed nitrogen air chamber pushes the stored water into the system. This allows the system to meet low-volume water demands without immediately triggering the pump motor. By creating this efficient supply cycle, the tank minimizes pump cycling, stabilizes water pressure, and conserves energy.

Key benefits

  • Provides ideal high-pressure delivery for high-rise buildings and long-distance applications
  • Extends equipment life by reducing pump starts and preventing motor burnout
  • Guarantees robust, stable water flow for showers, washers, and dishwashers
  • Zero maintenance required, saving time and servicing costs

Typical Applications

  • High-rise building water supply networks
  • Long-distance water pressure support systems
  • Residential and commercial booster pump systems
  • Appliance water pressure stabilization (washing machines, dishwashers)

Frequently Asked Question (FAQ)

Q1 : What makes the MEGA-2 a good choice for very small installations, and how is it packaged for shipping?

The MEGA-2 is highly compact with a 2-liter (0.5 gallon) capacity, measuring just 12.3 cm in diameter and 21.4 cm in height. For shipping convenience, it is packaged with 4 pieces per standard box, with a total box net weight of 3.2 kg.
 

Q2 : Will the MEGA-2 help save electricity?

Yes. By storing supplemental pressurized water, the MEGA-2 reduces the number of times your pump motor needs to turn on for small water demands. This ensures your water system works far more efficiently and saves energy.
 

Q3 : How does the MEGA-2’s 16-Bar rating compare to standard competitor tanks of this size?

While many standard residential expansion tanks from competitors are rated for a maximum of 10 Bar (150 PSI), the MEGA-2 offers a robust 16-Bar high-pressure rating. This makes it vastly superior for high-pressure booster water systems, ensuring structural integrity even during severe pressure surges.
